about_the_game:
Welcome to Keep Crafting, the co-op chaos simulator where teamwork makes... something vaguely functional!

Grab up to 3 friends (2 to 4 players total) and work together to build increasingly complex items for demanding "clients". Sounds easy? Not quite.

One player : the "Workshop Manager" can’t see the screen but holds the sacred manuals online through an interactive companion site. The others : the "Crafters" can see the workshop and operate the machines, but have no idea how they work without the Manager’s guidance.

Communicate, coordinate, and try not to question your friendship while you:

  • 🪓 Combine raw materials and questionable teamwork into impressive results

  • ⏰ Race against the clock, panic is part of the process!

  • 🧠 Rely on communication to operate mysterious machines

  • 🎮 Play locally or online with friends (friends not included with base edition of the game)

  • 🎭 Play through a story-driven campaign split into thematic chapters, each filled with new twists and challenges

  • 🧩 Unleash your creativity with the Level Editor and share your wildest designs

Whether you’re chopping wood, forging metal, or dyeing fabric the wrong color again, Keep Crafting turns every session into a hilarious test of coordination and communication.
